text: Read the plaque ahead, then take the door on the left.
Welcome. Walk up to the plaque on the far wall and read it.
Look straight at the big screen until it shows itself many levels deep.
A screen that shows whatever you're looking at. Read the plaque by the door.
Walk up to the big screen and look straight at it.
Answer the lectern's sentences: is each one true or false?
A picture that contains itself, which contains itself, and so on down. That's self-reference.
Now the sentences: the lectern on the right has woken up.
Not yet: this one only lights when a sentence can't be answered either way.
Both answers lead to a contradiction. A third button on the lectern has lit up.
Next: the Triangle, through the hall's left-hand door.
Climb the staircase and find the top.
A small room outside a stairwell. Read the plaque, then go through the door straight ahead and climb.
Each landing is one key higher. Listen to your footsteps as you climb.
Read the board. If you're convinced MU can't be made, press the red button beside it.
From up here you can see the machine from outside. Read the board on the wall: it shows every word you made.
In the vestibule, answer: where is the top of the staircase?
Back at C, at the door you came in. Yet every step went up.
Go out to the vestibule and answer the question on the wall.
Next: the Triangle, through the hall's left-hand door.
